indications_and_usage.t: Uses Dries the oozing and weeping of poison ivy, poison oak, and poison sumac and other skin irritations.

dosage_and_administration.t: Directions Adults and children 6 mo. of age and older: Shake well before using. Cleanse the skin with soap and water. Let dry before each use. Apply lotion to the affected area using cotton or soft cloth, as often as needed for comfort. Children under 6 mo. of age: Consult a doctor before use.
